public.firstAvailableHint: The first free barber takes care of you

join.title: Join the queue
join.presenceHint: You need to be at the shop to join: the QR displayed there and your position confirm it.
join.scanHint: Point at the QR code displayed in the shop.
join.nameHint: Shown at the counter, with only your last-name initial.
join.nameRequired: Enter your first name to join the queue.
join.emailHint: To find your spot from any device — a one-time code, no password.
join.submit: Join — your position will be checked
join.tokenExplainer: The QR displayed in the shop proves you are there. Your position is only requested at that moment.

issue.geo-denied: Without your position we cannot confirm you are at the shop. Allow location access and try again.
issue.geo-unavailable: Your position could not be determined. Move near a window and try again.
issue.scan-failed: That QR code is not this shop's. Scan the one displayed on site.
issue.otp-failed: That code is invalid or has expired. Check the latest email you received.
issue.email-send-failed: The email could not be sent. Check the address, or continue without an account.

refusal.service_area_has_no_queue: This professional travels to their clients: there is no live queue. Book a slot instead.
refusal.invalid_check_in_token: This QR code is no longer valid. Scan the one displayed in the shop.
refusal.location_not_geolocated: This shop has not published its position yet, so the queue cannot admit anyone. Let the counter know.
refusal.position_required: Your position is required to join: you need to be at the shop. Allow location access and try again.
refusal.too_far: You are too far from the shop to join its queue. Get closer and try again on site.
refusal.queue_closed: The queue is not taking anyone right now. Ask at the counter or come back later.
refusal.queue_full: The queue is full. Come back a little later, or book a slot.
refusal.already_in_queue: You are already in a queue. Finish or leave it before joining another.
refusal.barber_queue_disabled: This barber doesn't take a walk-in queue. Pick “First available” or another barber.
refusal.entry_not_found: This spot no longer exists. If the queue is open, you can join again.
refusal.not_entry_owner: This spot belongs to another account. Sign in with the account that joined the queue.
refusal.entry_already_closed: This spot is already over: there is nothing left to leave.
refusal.entry_in_service: You're in the chair — talk to your barber directly.
refusal.entry_not_waiting: Your spot is no longer waiting: switching queues isn't possible anymore.

track.enableNotifications: Alert me when it's my turn
track.notificationBody: {{organization}} is waiting for you. You have a few minutes to show up.

called.title: It's your turn
called.description: Head to the counter at {{organization}} — your spot is held for a few minutes.

gone.title: You are no longer in the queue
gone.description: Your visit is done, or your spot expired after being called. If the queue is open, you can join again.

track.estimatedWait: About {{minutes}} min of waiting ahead of you
track.deadlineCountdown: Your spot is held for another {{time}}
track.deadlinePassed: The window has passed — come to the counter, the shop decides.
track.movedNoticeFirstAvailable: You are now in the “first available” queue.

leaveConfirm.title: Leave the queue?
leaveConfirm.description: Your spot will be lost. To come back, you'll join at the end of the line.
leaveConfirm.calledDescription: You've been called: if you leave now, the shop will know and your spot will be lost.

changeSheet.title: Change barber
changeSheet.warning: Switching queues loses your current spot: you'll start again at the end of the new queue.

completed.title: All done — thank you!
completed.description: Your visit is recorded. See you soon.

left.title: You left the queue
left.description: Your spot is released. If you change your mind, join at the end of the line.

removedAuto.title: You're out of the queue
removedAuto.description: The window after your call had passed, so your spot was released. You can join again while the queue is open.

removedManual.title: Your spot was closed
removedManual.description: The shop closed your spot after the call. If the queue is open, you can join again.

empty.closedHint: The queue is closed — nobody can join.

toast.closed: Queue closed — customers already waiting stay in line.

noLocation.title: No location
noLocation.description: Create your location in the setup first.

serviceArea.title: No queue on a service area
serviceArea.description: A professional who travels has no waiting room: the queue only exists at a physical address.

moveSheet.title: Move {{name}}
moveSheet.description: The customer keeps their seniority in the new queue, and their screen tells them about the change.

barberQueues.title: Queues per barber
barberQueues.hint: A barber without a queue is not shown to customers and receives no one.

graceSweep.label: Automatic removal after the grace window
graceSweep.hint: Off: you decide, call by call. On: a called customer who doesn't show within the window leaves the queue, and their phone tells them — without blame.

qr.regenerateHint: Use this if you think the QR is circulating outside the shop: every printed copy becomes invalid immediately.

unavailable.title: QR not available
unavailable.description: Showing the QR is reserved for the owner, manager and front desk.

confirm.title: Regenerate the QR?
confirm.description: Every printed poster will stop working immediately. You will need to reprint.
confirm.done: New QR issued — reprint the poster.

poster.instruction: Scan to join the waiting line

setup.title: Set up FadeUp
setup.subtitle: From account to an open queue, in under twenty minutes.

salon.title: The shop
salon.description: Its name and FadeUp web address. Everything stays editable.

you.title: The first barber
you.description: The name customers will see. The rest of the team can be invited later.

address.title: Address and position
address.description: The position is what verifies a customer is on site before entering the queue.

services.title: Services
services.description: A starter catalogue, editable anytime. Adjust the prices.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.description: The typical week's open days and times.

activate.title: Free trial
activate.description: 14 days, no card. This is what activates the live queue.

open.title: Open the queue

qr.title: The QR on the wall
qr.description: Print the A5 poster and stick it in plain sight. You're done.

address.geoIssue: Position unavailable. Allow location access, while inside the shop.
address.whyPosition: Do this from inside the shop: this position guards the queue's door — a customer too far away cannot join.

activate.cta: Finish setup and start the trial
activate.hint: The trial opens the full product for 14 days, no card. If it lapses without a subscription: back to free, no data lost.

durations.title: Durations: declared vs observed
durations.description: Service after service, FadeUp measures real duration per barber and per service. The estimate shown to customers shifts from declared to observed as measurements accumulate.
durations.cappedHint: The gap between declared and observed exceeds ±50%: the display is bounded. Fix the declared duration, or check that “Done” is tapped at the right moment.

empty.title: No measurements yet
empty.description: As soon as a service is completed — walk-in or appointment — its real duration shows up here.

settings.title: Queue settings
settings.description: What decides capacity, grace delay and check-in radius. Everything is read from the database: nothing is hard-coded in the app.

capacity.label: Capacity per barber
capacity.hint: Beyond it, the queue refuses new arrivals. Between 1 and 200.

grace.label: Grace delay after the call
grace.hint: How long a called customer has to show up. Between 0 and 120 minutes.

geofence.label: Check-in radius
geofence.hint: Maximum distance to the shop to join the queue from a phone. Between 25 and 2000 metres.

settings.thresholdsUnavailable: This location's settings cannot be read right now. Reload the page; if they are still missing, report it.

empty.title: Nothing to set here
empty.description: Thresholds, per-barber queues and the automatic sweep are set by the owner or a manager. No duration has been measured yet.

settings.durationsHint: The real duration measured per barber and per service.
settings.durationsEmpty: No service measured yet. Observed durations appear here as soon as the first services are completed.

errors.capacityRange: Capacity per barber goes from 1 to 200.
errors.graceRange: The grace delay goes from 0 to 120 minutes.
errors.geofenceRange: The check-in radius goes from 25 to 2000 metres.
errors.notAuthorized: Only the owner and a manager can change these thresholds.
